units.source_text: 女人趴下，伸展开四肢，一边笑一边用手指弹了弹灯芯。

en.t: The woman lay face down, stretched out her limbs, and, laughing, flicked the lamp wick with her finger.
Before long, the lamp was lit again.

units.source_text: 女人还是那么个姿势，盯着灯上的火焰，脸上浮起做作的微笑。

en.t: The woman stayed in the same position, staring at the flame of the lamp, an affected smile rising on her face.

units.source_text: 他觉得这女人大概是为了将酒窝显露给别人看，才故意堆出微笑来的吧，他不由得身体僵硬起来。

en.t: He thought that perhaps this woman deliberately put on a smile just to show others her dimples, and despite himself his body stiffened.

units.source_text: 她只是说了贴近身旁的死，随后，他便多余地生出些猥亵的想法来。

en.t: She had merely spoken of death close at hand, and afterward he needlessly began to harbor obscene thoughts.
